chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Playing third alto for Hampton
summary: McRae retrieved his alto and filled in for Hampton for a couple of months before joining Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: Now you joined Hamp -- you went back to Hamp and were playing alto. He asked you to come back --
Had you had an alto all this time?
But you hadn't used it much.

No. Just went and got it. When he asked me to come get the alto, he had called me and say, "I want you to join me when I come through New York on alto." He called Joe Glaser. I say, "Okay." So I went and got my alto. Cleaned it (Inaudible) and tuned it up, worked on it, see if the mouthpiece was all right, and played third alto.
And you were with him that stint for about how long?
Oh, about a couple of in a place months. I just worked (inaudible) for a couple of
